# Solaris Engineering

Solaris Engineering is a professional engineering and construction firm based in Romania, specializing in renewable energy and advanced building solutions.

## Primary Services
- **Photovoltaic (Solar PV) Systems**: Full-cycle residential and industrial installations.
- **Roofing Solutions**: Specialized in TPO membranes for industrial buildings, metal sheet, and metal tiles.
- **Metal Works**: Design and installation of metal parapets and facades.
- **Construction & Repairs**: Comprehensive construction works, maintenance, and expert leak repairs.
